summary: A checkpoint no longer moves a seat's needs-login since: the harness.observed rule also keeps the credential report that ended the run before the current one

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change.

rules.detail: Rules version 24: harness.observed keeps one more claim per incarnation, the last provider_auth report of the other value before the current run. The rules digest changes, so members agree on a checkpoint only once they all run this build; until then, a member on the new rules waits instead of sealing with older peers.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. Checkpoints already trimmed keep what they dropped.

recovery.detail: Revert the build: later checkpoints use version 23 again.
